SPANISH CHAMPIONSHIP 2007

Event date: 22nd of July 2007
City: Hospitalet de Llobregat (Barcelona)
Country: Spain :)
Organizer: Marco Cortijo
Number of players: 64

A lot of players gathered last Sunday to play the LCQ for the
Spanish Championship, including our dear Bram Vink, from the
Netherlands ;-) who qualified the day before.

The seating in the final was:

Abel Tomasetti (Camarilla weenie vote deck with 1st Traditions) ->
Ginés Quiñonero (???) ->
Tomàs López (Kiasyd S&B deck) ->
Fran Martinez (War Ghoul deck) ->
Noel Gimenez (Rock Cat deck) ->

The weenie vote deck put a lot of pressure on his prey (Ginés) and
also put 2 First Traditions in play. The Rock Cart deck and Ginés
managed to oust the weenie vote deck, but that took too long and the
game timed out since no one else wanted to move forward.

So the winner of the Spanish Championship is Noel Giménez.

In this tournament, Noel qualified for the Continental Championships,
and both Noel and Tomàs López had their plane tickets to Gothenburg
(EC 2007) paid as a prize for being 1st and 2nd, respectively.
